items.title: Sensex Today | Stock Market Live: GIFT Nifty signals a higher start; US, Asian markets gain
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates: US stocks ended sharply higher on Thursday, with ​indexes extending gains after U.S. President Donald Trump said he canceled planned strikes against Iran, and on the eve of the ‌market debut of Elon Musk's SpaceX. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose ​929.97 points, or 1.86%, to 50,848.75, the S&P 500 gained 127.31 points, or 1.75%, to 7,394.30 and the Nasdaq Composite gained 640.16 points, or 2.54%, to 25,809.66.

items.title: First Tick: Top global cues to watch in today’s trade
items.description: Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) remained net sellers for the 12th consecutive trading session, though the intensity of outflows has moderated over the last four sessions. On June 11, FIIs sold equities worth Rs 1,987 crore. In contrast, Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) continued to provide strong support to the market, extending their buying streak to the 18th straight session. DIIs purchased equities worth Rs 4,224 crore on the day.
